title.da: Likvideringen af Hestetyven på Rosengårdens Bodega
title.en: The liquidation of The Horse Thief at Rosengårdens Bodega

description.da: Den 20. april 1944 kl. 17:05 — bevidst valgt som Hitlers fødselsdag — trådte to BOPA-modstandsfolk ind på Rosengårdens Bodega, Rosengården 11. De fulgte Christian Marius Rudolf Christiansen, kaldt 'Hestetyven', fra H.C. Ørstedsparken og affyrede skud mod ham ved bardisken. Hestetyven var i årevis gået under dække som kommunistisk agitator, mens han i virkeligheden stak folk an til det danske politis efterretningstjeneste og siden til det tyske Gestapo. Hans informationer førte direkte til arrestationen af kommunisternes MF Aksel Larsen og deportationen af talrige modstandsfolk til koncentrationslejre. Han forsøgte at trække sin egen pistol, men nåede det ikke. En kugle sidder stadig i væggen bag baren — og tradition byder at den vises frem til gæster der køber et shot.
description.en: On 20 April 1944 at 17:05 — deliberately chosen as Hitler's birthday — two BOPA resistance members entered Rosengårdens Bodega at Rosengården 11. They had followed Christian Marius Rudolf Christiansen, known as 'The Horse Thief', from H.C. Ørstedsparken and fired at him at the bar counter. The Horse Thief had spent years posing as a communist agitator while in reality informing on members to the Danish police intelligence service and later to the German Gestapo. His information directly led to the arrest of communist MP Aksel Larsen and the deportation of numerous resistance members to concentration camps. He attempted to draw his own pistol but did not manage to. A bullet remains embedded in the wall behind the bar to this day — by tradition, guests who buy a shot may be shown the bullet hole.

The RAF raid on Shell House

description.da: Den 21. marts 1945 kl. 11 angreb 18 britiske de Havilland Mosquito-bombefly Shellhuset på H.C. Andersens Boulevard — Gestapos hovedkvarter i København, hvor tyske efterretningsakter og fangne danske modstandsfolk var opbevaret. Angrebet, der var kodename Operation Carthage, lykkedes: vestfløjen blev lagt næsten i ruiner, 18 fanger slap fri, og over 100 Gestapo-officerer og kollaboratører blev dræbt. Men katastrofen fulgte umiddelbart efter: et af flyene fløj for lavt, ragede en bygning på Palnatokesgade og styrtede ned nær Institut Jeanne d'Arc i Frederiksberg. Efterfølgende fly forvekslede vraget og røgen med målet og bombede skolen — 87 skolebørn og 18 voksne omkom.
description.en: On 21 March 1945 at 11:00, 18 British de Havilland Mosquito bombers attacked Shell House on H.C. Andersens Boulevard — the Gestapo headquarters in Copenhagen, where German intelligence files and captured Danish resistance members were held. The operation, codenamed Operation Carthage, succeeded: the west wing was reduced nearly to rubble, 18 prisoners were freed, and over 100 Gestapo officers and collaborators were killed. But catastrophe followed immediately: one aircraft flew too low, grazed a building on Palnatokesgade and crashed near Institut Jeanne d'Arc in Frederiksberg. Following aircraft mistook the wreck and smoke for the target and bombed the school — 87 schoolchildren and 18 adults were killed.

description.da: Under angrebet på Shellhuset den 21. marts 1945 fløj et af de britiske Mosquito-bombefly for lavt og ragede en bygning på Palnatokesgade. Skrammerne i facaden sidder der endnu — et stille vidne om det øjeblik flyet mistede kontrol. Det beskadigede fly styrtede kort efter ned nær Institut Jeanne d'Arc i Frederiksberg, og røgen fra vraget fik efterfølgende piloter til at forveksle stedet med Shellhuset og bombe skolen i stedet. 11 mennesker omkom ved selve nedstyrtet.
description.en: During the attack on Shell House on 21 March 1945, one of the British Mosquito bombers flew too low and grazed a building on Palnatokesgade. The scrape marks in the facade are still visible today — a quiet witness to the moment the aircraft lost control. The damaged plane crashed shortly after near Institut Jeanne d'Arc in Frederiksberg, and the smoke from the wreck led following pilots to mistake the site for Shell House and bomb the school instead. 11 people were killed in the crash itself.

source: Lars K. Jensen / Flickr — fotoserie fra Palnatokesgade

title.en: The Execution Shed — Denmark's last execution

description.da: På Holmen, dybt inde i det der i dag er Christiania, ligger betonpladen der er alt der er tilbage af Henrettelsesskuret — et specielt bygget træskur med støbt gulv og afløbsrist, hvor 30 danskere blev skudt efter besættelsestidens retsopgør. Skuret var officielt tegnet som 'pistolskydeplads, skur til skiver' for at skjule dets egentlige formål. Den 20. juli 1950 kl. 01:00 blev Ib Birkedal Hansen skudt her — det var Danmarks foreløbigt sidste henrettelse. I alt 46 mennesker blev henrettet i retsopgøret: 30 her og 16 ved Undallslund nær Viborg. En replika af skuret blev opført i 1980.
description.en: On Holmen, deep within what is now Christiania, lies the concrete slab that is all that remains of the Execution Shed — a purpose-built wooden structure with a cast floor and drainage grate where 30 Danes were shot following the post-war legal settlement. The shed was officially drawn up as a 'pistol range, shed for targets' to conceal its true purpose. On 20 July 1950 at 01:00, Ib Birkedal Hansen was shot here — Denmark's last execution to date. In total, 46 people were executed during the legal settlement: 30 here and 16 at Undallslund near Viborg. A replica of the shed was erected in 1980.

description.da: Den 22. juni 1944 gennemførte sabotagegruppen BOPA et af besættelsestidens mest spektakulære angreb på skibsværftet Burmeister & Wain på Refshaleøen. Eksplosionerne ødelagde maskinhaller og forsinkede tysk krigsskibsproduktion betragteligt. Aktionen var en af de største industrielle sabotagehandlinger under den tyske besættelse af Danmark.
description.en: On 22 June 1944, the sabotage group BOPA carried out one of the most spectacular attacks of the occupation at the Burmeister & Wain shipyard on Refshaleøen. The explosions destroyed machine halls and significantly delayed German warship production. The action was one of the largest industrial sabotage operations during the German occupation of Denmark.

source: Frihedsmuseet / The Museum of Danish Resistance

description.da: En af 1930'ernes mest omtalte mordssager i København. Sagen skabte massiv medieopmærksomhed og satte spørgsmålstegn ved politiets efterforskningsmetoder. Gerningsstedet på Nørreport-kvarteret blev et mørkt kapitel i byens kriminalhistorie.
description.en: One of the most talked-about murder cases in 1930s Copenhagen. The case attracted massive media attention and raised questions about police investigative methods. The crime scene in the Nørreport quarter became a dark chapter in the city's criminal history.

title.en: Bombing of the synagogue in Krystalgade

description.da: Den 22. juli 1985 blev der kastet en håndgranat mod den jødiske synagoge i Krystalgade i det indre København. Attentatet skete samme nat som et angreb mod NordJyske Bank i Fredericia, og begge aktioner menes at have forbindelse til palæstinensiske terrorgrupper. Ingen blev dræbt, men angrebet rystede det jødiske samfund i Danmark.
description.en: On 22 July 1985, a hand grenade was thrown at the Jewish synagogue in Krystalgade in central Copenhagen. The attack occurred the same night as an attack on NordJyske Bank in Fredericia, and both actions are believed to be connected to Palestinian terrorist groups. No one was killed, but the attack shook the Jewish community in Denmark.

title.en: Wikipedia — Attack on the Krystalgade synagogue
The double murder at Restaurant Søpromenaden

description.da: Den 24. september 1983 kl. 03:15 gik tre Bullshit-rockere og en kvindelig bekendt ind på Restaurant Søpromenaden på hjørnet af Øster Farimagsgade og Øster Søgade ved Lille Triangel på Østerbro — et velkendt tilholdssted for Hells Angels. Barmanden ringede straks til Bent Svane Nielsen, kaldet Blondie, 25 år og Hells Angels-aktivist. Nielsen mødte op med tre medskyldige og gik til angreb med knive og flasker. Steen Grabow Grander (20 år) og Flemming Hald Jensen (21 år), begge Bullshit-rockere, blev dræbt på stedet. En tredje rocker, Michael Peter Enoch, overlevede alvorligt kvæstet. Kvinden slap uskadet. Baggrunden var en territorial aftale: Bullshit skulle holde sig på Amager, Hells Angels kontrollerede resten af København. At drikke på H.A.'s stamværtshus var en direkte provokation. Den 21. september 1984 blev Nielsen ved nævningeting i Østre Landsret idømt 16 års fængsel; Henrik Kruse Jensen fik 5 år og Hansi Hansen 4 år. Nielsen blev prøveløsladt i 1994. De historiske lokaler (i dag Øster Søgade 114) huser nu restauranten Famo Metro — den nuværende café Søpromenaden ligger stik overfor og har intet med den oprindelige at gøre.
description.en: On 24 September 1983 at 03:15, three Bullshit rockers and a female acquaintance entered Restaurant Søpromenaden at the corner of Øster Farimagsgade and Øster Søgade at Lille Triangel in Østerbro — a well-known Hells Angels gathering place. The bartender immediately called Bent Svane Nielsen, known as Blondie, a 25-year-old Hells Angels activist. Nielsen arrived with three accomplices and attacked with knives and bottles. Steen Grabow Grander (20) and Flemming Hald Jensen (21), both Bullshit members, were killed on the spot. A third rocker, Michael Peter Enoch, survived with serious injuries. The woman escaped unharmed. The background was a territorial agreement: Bullshit was to stay on Amager while Hells Angels controlled the rest of Copenhagen. Drinking at an H.A. pub was a direct provocation. On 21 September 1984, Nielsen was sentenced to 16 years by the Eastern High Court; Henrik Kruse Jensen received 5 years and Hansi Hansen 4 years. Nielsen was conditionally released in 1994. The original premises (today Øster Søgade 114) now house the restaurant Famo Metro — the café named Søpromenaden directly across the street has no connection to the original.

title.en: The liquidation of Makrellen on Agerlandsvej

description.da: Den 25. maj 1984 sad Henning Norbert Knudsen — kaldet Makrellen — præsident for rockerbanden Bullshit, i sin bil foran hjemmet på Agerlandsvej 19 på Amager. Jørn »Jønke« Nielsen fra Hells Angels havde skjult sig i en nærliggende bil. Da Makrellen satte sig ind, åbnede Jønke ild gennem forruden med en Stengun maskinpistol — derefter en ny salve i ryggen. Makrellen hang halvt ud af bildøren, ramt af 16 skud i hals, bryst og ryg. Hans 22-årige hustru Pia Soldthved Larsen nåede at springe ud og komme i sikkerhed. Jønke flygtede til Frankrig og siden Canada, men vendte hjem den 3. marts 1988 og blev i 1989 ved landsretten idømt 16 års fængsel. Fire Hells Angels-medlemmer blev sigtet som medvirkende — herunder den 28-årige Christian Sass Middelboe, der ved et nævningeting den 22. marts 1985 fik syv år for medvirken. Ironisk nok var det den samme Middelboe, der 12 år senere som national H.A.-formand blev såret under raketangrebet på Titangade. Mordet var et afgørende punkt i den blodige konflikt mellem Bullshit og Hells Angels, der fra 1980 til 1988 kostede et dusin rokkere livet — de fleste fra Bullshit.
description.en: On 25 May 1984, Henning Norbert Knudsen — known as Makrellen (The Mackerel) — president of the Bullshit motorcycle gang, was sitting in his car outside his home at Agerlandsvej 19 on Amager. Jørn 'Jønke' Nielsen of the Hells Angels had concealed himself in a nearby car. As Makrellen got in, Jønke opened fire through the windshield with a Stengun submachine gun — then a second burst into his back. Makrellen hung half out of the car door, struck by 16 shots to the neck, chest and back. His 22-year-old wife Pia Soldthved Larsen managed to jump clear to safety. Jønke fled to France and then Canada, but returned on 3 March 1988 and was sentenced in 1989 to 16 years imprisonment by the Court of Appeal. Four Hells Angels members were charged as accomplices — including 28-year-old Christian Sass Middelboe, who on 22 March 1985 received seven years for complicity. Ironically, that same Middelboe — by then the national H.A. president — would be among the wounded in the rocket attack on Titangade twelve years later. The murder was a defining moment in the bloody conflict between Bullshit and Hells Angels, which between 1980 and 1988 claimed around a dozen lives — most of them from Bullshit.

source: Wikipedia — Jønke · Ugeavisen Amager — Bakspejlet: Rockermordet på Agerlandsvej

title.da: Lufthavnsdrabet — Hells Angels skyder Bandidos i Kastrup
title.en: The Airport Murder — Hells Angels shoot Bandidos at Kastrup

description.da: Den 10. marts 1996 kl. 16:25 åbnede flere Hells Angels-rockere ild med pistoler og maskinpistoler mod en bil på parkeringspladsen foran Kastrup Lufthavn, hvor fire Bandidos-rockere sad. Mindst 37 skud blev affyret — politiet fandt 33 patronhylstre spredt over 150 meter. Uffe Lindenskov Larsen (32 år) blev ramt af syv skud i hjerte, lunger, hoved og ben og dræbt på stedet. Tre andre Bandidos-rockere blev alvorligt såret. Angrebet var planlagt fra Hells Angels' hovedkvarter på Titangade og var udløst af en eskalerende territorialkonflikt. Michael Brokside (23 år) blev den 20. december 1996 idømt 16 år. Jørgen »Fehår« Nielsen og to medgerningsmænd fik livsvarigt fængsel ved Højesteret i 1998. Lufthavnsdrabet regnes som startskuddet på Den Store Nordiske Rockerkrig — Bandidos svarede igen syv måneder senere med raketangrebet mod Titangade i oktober 1996.
description.en: On 10 March 1996 at 16:25, several Hells Angels fired pistols and submachine guns at a car in the parking area outside Kastrup Airport, where four Bandidos members were sitting. At least 37 shots were fired — police found 33 shell casings spread across 150 metres. Uffe Lindenskov Larsen (32) was hit by seven shots to the heart, lungs, head and legs and killed on the spot. Three other Bandidos were seriously wounded. The attack had been planned at the Hells Angels' headquarters on Titangade and was triggered by an escalating territorial conflict. Michael Brokside (23) was sentenced to 16 years on 20 December 1996. Jørgen 'Fehår' Nielsen and two co-perpetrators received life sentences upheld by the Supreme Court in 1998. The airport murder is regarded as the opening shot of the Great Nordic Biker War — Bandidos responded seven months later with the rocket attack on Titangade in October 1996.

source: Wikipedia — Michael Brokside · TV 2: 1998-rocker dømt for lufthavnsdrab

The rocket attack on the Hells Angels' Titangade clubhouse

description.da: Den 6. oktober 1996 kl. 03:05 affyrede en Bandidos-prospect en Carl Gustav-antitankraket mod Hells Angels' klubhus på Titangade 11 i Nørrebro, mens over 100 gæster var samlet til den årlige Vikingefest. Skytten affyrede raketten fra taget af en nærliggende cykelparkering, hen over politikøretøjer, der stod opstillet uden for bygningen. Raketten flød igennem bygningen uden at sprænge — tændmekanismen svigtede — men ilden og varmen fra dens fremdriftssystem omdannede det tætpakkede rum til en smelteovn. To mennesker omkom: Louis Linde Nielsen (38 år), H.A.-prospect, og Janne Krohn (29 år), en civil kvinde. 19 personer blev såret, herunder H.A. Danmarks nationale præsident Christian Sass Middelboe. Angrebet var et af de mest dramatiske episoder under Den Store Nordiske Rockerkrig (1995–1997) — en voldelig konflikt mellem Hells Angels og Bandidos om territorium i Skandinavien.
description.en: On 6 October 1996 at 03:05, a Bandidos prospect fired a Carl Gustav anti-tank rocket at the Hells Angels' clubhouse at Titangade 11 in Nørrebro, while over 100 guests were gathered for the annual Viking Party. The shooter fired from the roof of an adjacent bicycle shelter, passing over police vehicles stationed outside the building. The rocket passed through the building without exploding — the detonator failed — but the heat from its propulsion system turned the packed room into a furnace. Two people died: Louis Linde Nielsen (38), an H.A. prospect, and Janne Krohn (29), a civilian woman. Nineteen were wounded, including H.A. Denmark national president Christian Sass Middelboe. The attack was one of the most dramatic episodes of the Great Nordic Biker War (1995–1997) — a violent conflict between Hells Angels and Bandidos over territory across Scandinavia.

source: Politimuseet — Da Norden eksploderede · Wikipedia — Den Store Nordiske Rockerkrig

title.da: Niels Albret drabet — liget i betongulvet på Christiania
title.en: The Niels Albret murder — body in the concrete floor at Christiania

description.da: Den 27. januar 1987 skød Peter »Panik« Espensen den 28-årige SAS-portør Niels-Aage Albret på Bullshits klubhus, Kirkegårdsvej 7 på Amager — han var mistænkt for at være politiinformant. Liget blev herefter transporteret til Bullshits værksted i Multihuset på Christiania og støbt ind i cementgulvet. 252 dage senere, den 6. oktober 1987, blev liget opdaget af christianitter. Reaktionen var øjeblikkelig: christianitterne malede »Befriet område« på Bullshits fæstning i Multihuset, opstillede vagtposter ved alle udgange og tvang i løbet af kort tid alle Bullshit-rockere ud af fristadet for altid. Peter Espensen idømtes 12 år i Østre Landsret i 1988, skærpet til 14 år af Højesteret. Bemærk: Sagen omtales i populærkulturen undertiden under andre navne.
description.en: On 27 January 1987, Peter 'Panik' Espensen shot 28-year-old SAS porter Niels-Aage Albret at the Bullshit clubhouse at Kirkegårdsvej 7 on Amager — he was suspected of being a police informant. The body was then transported to Bullshit's workshop in Multihuset at Christiania and cast into the concrete floor. 252 days later, on 6 October 1987, the body was discovered by Christiania residents. The reaction was immediate: Christianites painted 'Liberated Area' on Bullshit's stronghold in Multihuset, stationed guards at all exits, and within a short time forced all Bullshit rockers out of the free city permanently. Peter Espensen was sentenced to 12 years by the Eastern High Court in 1988, increased to 14 years by the Supreme Court. Note: the case is sometimes referenced under other names in popular culture.

source: Drabssager.dk — Peter Espensen idømt fængsel for drab på Niels Albret i 1987

title.da: Likvideringen af Karate-Claus på A.F. Beyersvej
title.en: The liquidation of Karate-Claus on A.F. Beyersvej

description.da: Den 21. marts 2001 blev Claus Barrit Bork Hansen (37 år), kaldet »Karate-Claus«, skudt og dræbt med 26 skud på A.F. Beyersvej i Vanløse, da han vendte hjem fra en restaurantbesøg med sin kæreste. Hansen havde været en af Bandidos' mest magtfulde skikkelser — Sergeant-at-Arms og Jim Tinndahns livvagt under Den Store Nordiske Rockerkrig — men var siden blevet smidt ud af Bandidos og omdannet sit Hedehusene-kapitel til støtteklub for Hells Angels. Politiet havde to gange advaret ham om at han stod på Bandidos' dødsliste, men han afviste beskyttelse. Den 41-årige Jens Christian Thorup idømtes livsvarigt fængsel den 12. april 2002 ved Østre Landsret — dommen blev i januar 2003 nedsat til 16 år.
description.en: On 21 March 2001, Claus Barrit Bork Hansen (37), known as 'Karate-Claus', was shot and killed with 26 shots on A.F. Beyersvej in Vanløse as he returned home from a restaurant visit with his girlfriend. Hansen had been one of Bandidos' most powerful figures — Sergeant-at-Arms and bodyguard to Jim Tinndahn during the Great Nordic Biker War — but had since been expelled from Bandidos and converted his Hedehusene chapter into a Hells Angels support club. Police had warned him twice that he was on Bandidos' death list, but he refused protection. Jens Christian Thorup (41) was sentenced to life imprisonment on 12 April 2002 by the Eastern High Court — the sentence was reduced to 16 years in January 2003.

source: Wikipedia — Drabet på Claus Bork Hansen

title.da: Trippeldrabet på Frederiksberg — tre mænd skudt i søvne
title.en: The Frederiksberg triple murder — three men shot in their sleep

description.da: Natten til den 11. november 2015 kravlede gerningsmændene ad stilladserne op til en lejlighed på Christian Paulsens Vej 26 på Frederiksberg og ind gennem et køkkenvindue. Inde lå Mike Patrick Vinther (24), Phillip F.L. Rasmussen (19) og Suhaib Khalil Jaffar (23) og sov. Alle tre blev skudt med haglgevær og pistol. Ofrene tilhørte den Vanløse-baserede kriminelle gruppe »Holdet«, der var i konflikt med Bandidos. To uger inden drabet var Bandidos-medl Umar Asghar blevet knivstukket ved et møde med de tre ofre på taget af Rødovre Centrum. Den 34-årige Bandidos-rocker Ian Ramm Hansen idømtes livsvarigt fængsel — stadfæstet i landsretten i 2018. Benyamin Rahimi fik 12 år. Politiet opklarede sagen bl.a. via en Smith & Wesson .38 revolver, der var solgt dagen inden drabene.
description.en: In the early hours of 11 November 2015, perpetrators climbed scaffolding to an apartment at Christian Paulsens Vej 26 in Frederiksberg and entered through a kitchen window. Inside, Mike Patrick Vinther (24), Phillip F.L. Rasmussen (19) and Suhaib Khalil Jaffar (23) lay sleeping. All three were shot with a shotgun and pistol. The victims belonged to the Vanløse-based criminal group 'Holdet', which was in conflict with Bandidos. Two weeks before the murder, Bandidos member Umar Asghar had been stabbed at a meeting with the three victims on the roof of Rødovre Centrum. 34-year-old Bandidos member Ian Ramm Hansen was sentenced to life imprisonment — upheld on appeal in 2018. Benyamin Rahimi received 12 years. Police cracked the case partly via a Smith & Wesson .38 revolver sold the day before the killings.

source: Wikipedia — Trippeldrabet på Frederiksberg · DR Nyheder

title.da: Jaguaren — Taxa-Torbens parterede lig i Klerkegade
title.en: Jaguar — Taxi driver Torben's dismembered body in Klerkegade

description.da: Natten til den 25. marts 2005 — påskenat — tog taxachauffør Torben Vagn Knudsen (41 år) hjem med to mænd han havde mødt på et værtshus: sudaneseren Ahmed Numan Isaac Rahma, kaldet »Jaguaren«, og den amerikanske backpacker Jared Heller, kaldet »Amerikaneren«. De købte øl og cigaretter i en 7-Eleven og kørte til Jaguarens lejlighed. Her stak Jaguaren Torben ihjel med flere knivstik i halsen. Liget blev derefter parteret. Lørdag morgen den 26. marts fandt en forbipasserende en arm og begge ben anbragt på en palle ved en mandskabsvogn i Klerkegade. Mandag den 28. marts fandt en hundeluftende torso og hoved — begge delt — i en kælderskakt på Adelgade 106, blot få meter fra Klerkegade. Jared Heller meldte sig selv til politiet den 7. april og forklarede at Jaguaren havde tvunget ham til at hjælpe med at bortskafe liget. Heller idømtes fire måneders fængsel for usømmelig omgang med lig og udvisning. Ahmed »Jaguaren« Rahma flygtede Danmark og efterlyses stadig internationalt via Interpol.
description.en: In the early hours of 25 March 2005 — Easter Saturday night — taxi driver Torben Vagn Knudsen (41) went home with two men he had met at a pub: Sudanese national Ahmed Numan Isaac Rahma, known as 'Jaguar', and American backpacker Jared Heller, known as 'The American'. They bought beer and cigarettes at a 7-Eleven and went to Jaguar's apartment. There, Jaguar stabbed Torben to death with multiple knife wounds to the throat. The body was then dismembered. On Saturday morning, 26 March, a passer-by found an arm and both legs placed on a pallet beside a construction vehicle in Klerkegade. On Monday, 28 March, a dog walker found the torso and head — both split — in a basement shaft at Adelgade 106, just metres from Klerkegade. Jared Heller turned himself in on 7 April and explained that Jaguar had forced him to help dispose of the body. Heller was sentenced to four months for indecent handling of a corpse and deported. Ahmed 'Jaguar' Rahma fled Denmark and remains internationally wanted via Interpol.

The bomb explosion at Hotel Jørgensen

description.da: Den 10. september 2010 kl. 13:23 eksploderede en hjemmelavet bombe i et toilet på Hotel Jørgensen, Rømersgade 11 i København. Den 24-årige tjetjensk-belgiske mand Lors Doukaiev var indlogeret på hotellet under falsk navn og var i gang med at samle en TATP-bombe med stålkugler — designet som en brevbombe rettet mod avisen Jyllands-Posten i Aarhus, der i 2005 havde trykt Muhammed-tegningerne. Bomben eksploderede utilsigtet under sammensætningen. Kun Doukaiev selv blev såret. En ladet pistol blev fundet på hans værelse.
description.en: On 10 September 2010 at 13:23, a homemade bomb exploded in a toilet at Hotel Jørgensen, Rømersgade 11 in Copenhagen. The 24-year-old Chechen-Belgian man Lors Doukaiev was staying at the hotel under a false name and was assembling a TATP bomb packed with steel ball bearings — designed as a letter bomb targeting the newspaper Jyllands-Posten in Aarhus, which had published the Muhammad cartoons in 2005. The bomb detonated accidentally during assembly. Only Doukaiev himself was injured. A loaded pistol was found in his room.

description.da: Efter at bomben utilsigtet eksploderede på hans hotelværelse flygtede Lors Doukaiev ind i den nærliggende Ørstedsparken. Kl. 15:38 — godt to timer efter eksplosionen — blev han anholdt af politiet i parken. Doukaiev havde mistet et ben tidligere i livet og var i pressen kendt som 'den etbenede terrorist'. Han blev i 2011 idømt 12 års fængsel for forsøg på terrorisme og udleveret til Belgien i 2013. Hotel Jørgensen lukkede i 2020.
description.en: After the bomb accidentally exploded in his hotel room, Lors Doukaiev fled into the nearby Ørstedsparken. At 15:38 — just over two hours after the explosion — he was arrested by police in the park. Doukaiev had previously lost a leg and was known in the press as 'the one-legged terrorist'. In 2011 he was sentenced to 12 years in prison for attempted terrorism and was extradited to Belgium in 2013. Hotel Jørgensen closed in 2020.

description.da: Fra en tilsyneladende helt almindelig lejlighed på Blekingegade 2 på Amager opererede en gruppe politiske aktivister i dybeste hemmelighed i over et årti. Gruppen, der kaldte sig Kommunistisk Arbejdskreds, begik en række væbnede røverier mod banker og posthuse for at finansiere palæstinensiske guerillabevægelser — herunder PFLP. Lejligheden fungerede som base for planlægning og opbevaring af udstyr.
description.en: From an outwardly ordinary apartment at Blekingegade 2 on Amager, a group of political activists operated in deep secrecy for over a decade. The group, calling themselves the Communist Working Circle, committed a series of armed robberies against banks and post offices to fund Palestinian guerrilla movements — including the PFLP. The apartment served as a base for planning and storing equipment.

description.da: Den 2. november 1988 forsøgte Blekingegadebanden at røve en pansret pengetransport ved Nørre Voldgade i det indre København. Under flugten blev politibetjent Jesper Duus Jensen skudt og dræbt. Det var Danmarks mest alvorlige røveridrab i nyere tid og udløste den største politiefterforskning i danmarkshistorien. Alle bandens medlemmer blev anholdt og idømt lange fængselsstraffe.
description.en: On 2 November 1988, the Blekingegade Gang attempted to rob an armoured money transport at Nørre Voldgade in central Copenhagen. During the escape, police officer Jesper Duus Jensen was shot and killed. It was Denmark's most serious robbery-murder in modern times and triggered the largest police investigation in Danish history. All gang members were arrested and sentenced to long prison terms.
